async def act(page):
    # Search for the project 'solarized-prism-theme' using the filter searchbox
    search_box = page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Filter by name...')
    await search_box.fill('solarized-prism-theme')
    await search_box.press('Enter')

    project_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='solarized-prism-theme', exact=True)
    await project_link.click()
